title: PEDROLUNET.DEV
description:
A personal portfolio built with Svelte and GSAP, inspired by digital brutalism and Swiss design principles. It uses a dense grid, clear typographic hierarchy, and motion to present my projects and thoughts.

I started this project because my previous portfolio no longer felt like an authentic reflection of me or my work. I wanted a more personal space that better represented my visual preferences while giving me room to explore Svelte 5 and interactive motion.

title: DODIA.PT
description: Dodia was my first professional project, built during my curricular internship at Significa. It is a community-driven web app where users can post and browse the daily menus of local restaurants, or tascas, when deciding where to eat.

title: DOT JOURNAL
description: Dot Journal is a minimalist web journal built with Svelte to explore Svelte 5's features. It stores entries locally and lets users record their thoughts without distractions. Users can also customize each day with a colored dot, making past entries easier to find.

title: JUNTO.
description: Junto is a social platform for sharing and discussing movies, books, and music, developed for the LBAW (Database and Web Applications Laboratory) course at FEUP.
